what: Over the pane, each time the cursor moves 80px, the next photo in the stack lands on top at the cursor position (photo center), then immediately splits into 3×3 pieces (clip-path). Each piece scatters ±15px, shrinks to .8~1x and fades out (.25s power2.out, .005s piece stagger, .02s delay). On activation it auto-sweeps the pane from 20% to 80% once over 1.3s power2.inOut (after .3s). Not enabled below 768px.

options.gap: Cursor travel distance to place one photo (px), default 80
options.spread: Max distance pieces are pushed (px), default 15
options.min: Minimum screen width to turn on (px), default 768
options.on: With state, the plate does not turn on by itself even when visible, and is turned on and off with fx:play / fx:stop events (only within one stretch of a pinned section)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Single photo frame — inside it [data-fx-part=inner] (background image·img) is duplicated and sliced by the number of pieces

note: The photo box is moved with a transform anchored at the panel’s top left. To keep text on the panel from being covered, the caller puts the text at a higher z
